core_obligations: Set up the induction (proof lines 14258-14268): choose a <= b with H^i(K) = 0 outside [a, b] and prove by induction on b - a that after passing to a covering there is a representing complex of constant sheaves on finite type modules concentrated in [a, b]; the case b = a is clear.

Make the top cohomology constant and lift generators (proof lines 14268-14280): after replacing X by the members of a covering one may assume H^b(K) is constant on a finite type module M; choosing generators x_1, ..., x_r, a generalization of the covering lemma gives a covering over which each x_i lifts to a class in H^b, so that there is a map from the constant sheaf on Lambda^{oplus r} shifted into degree b inducing a surjection on H^b.

Induction step (proof lines 14280-14308): complete this map to a distinguished triangle; the cohomology sheaves of L live in [a, b-1], and the displayed short exact sequence together with local constancy of the kernel shows H^{b-1}(L) is locally constant of finite type, so the induction hypothesis represents L by a complex of constant sheaves on finite modules; the map L -> Lambda^{oplus r}[-b+1] becomes locally constant, hence after passing to a covering comes from a map of modules, and the axioms of triangulated categories then produce an isomorphism from the complex M^a -> ... -> M^{b-1} -> Lambda^{oplus r} to K.
proof_roadmap: Induct on the length of the interval in which the cohomology is concentrated.
Pass to a covering making the top cohomology constant, lift generators of the finite module, and build a surjection onto the top cohomology.
Use the resulting distinguished triangle, local constancy of the kernel and the induction hypothesis to extend the representing complex by one term.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a site with final object, a Noetherian ring Lambda and a bounded complex K whose cohomology sheaves are locally constant of finite type, there is a covering over which K is represented by a complex of locally constant sheaves of finite type (statement lines 14246-14256). The proof (proof lines 14258-14313) is an induction on the length of the interval containing the cohomology: it passes to a covering making the top cohomology constant, lifts generators to cohomology classes, and uses the associated distinguished triangle together with the local constancy of the kernel to extend the representing complex by one term. H2: a full induction with four inputs, written out in full.
